WMV® on Instagram: "Justin Bieber is facing backlash after his 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival performance and reportedly earning a massive $10 million fee.

The pop star performed 34 songs during his headlining set, mixing fan favorites like “Baby,” “Sorry,” and “Where Are Ü Now” with newer tracks and special guest appearances.

However, fans were divided, because while Bieber drew a huge crowd and brought out artists like Dijon and Tems, many criticized parts of the show, especially moments where he sat behind a laptop playing old YouTube videos — calling the performance “lazy” for such a high-paid headline act.

Still, the set marked Bieber’s biggest live performance in years, following his 2022 tour which was cancelled prematurely. Following that Bieber sold the interest in his catalog to Hipgnosis Songs Fund for $200M. 

📸: @coachella"
